title: Crispy Paneer Skillet
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring crispy paneer, served in a skillet with a blend of spices.
instructions: 2. In a shallow dish, mix together the all-purpose flour, gram flour, and a pinch of salt.
3. Dredge the paneer cubes in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 1-2 seconds.
6. Add the paneer cubes and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 2-3 minutes.
7. Remove the paneer from the skillet and set aside.
8. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil.
9. Add the coriander powder, garam masala, and a pinch of salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
10. Add the cooked paneer back to the skillet and toss with the spice mixture.
11. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
